relationships.history: Saturday pickup partners. Dax wins; Andre gets the better stories out of it.
They were together for two years in Miami. He left for a tour and didn't come back for a month.
She art-directed his last cover. He hasn't stopped thinking about her since.
The kid from the Copper Tap's storeroom has ears. Andre gave him the B room and checks his sessions more often than he admits.

memories.info: The night Aaliyah threw his things out of a Miami Beach balcony.
Produced 'Golden Hour', the song that put his name on the map.

profile.tagline: Makes the town's soundtrack. Makes his own rules.

appearance.face: defined jawline, thin mustache and chin beard, playful smile, small gold hoop earrings
appearance.hair: short locs with a taper fade
appearance.style: olive suede bomber jacket, black tank, black cargo pants, olive-and-white sneakers, gold Cuban chain, gold watch and bracelet

outfits.everyday: olive suede bomber jacket, black tank, black cargo pants, olive-and-white sneakers, gold Cuban chain, gold watch and bracelet
outfits.work: oversized charcoal hoodie, black joggers, black slides over white socks, studio headphones around his neck, gold Cuban chain, gold watch
outfits.evening: black silk camp-collar shirt open at the neck, tailored black trousers, black leather Chelsea boots, gold Cuban chain, gold watch and bracelet

appearance.silhouette: relaxed bomber over a long, lean frame

profile.family_background: Grew up in Flatbush above his grandmother's record shop. His father played bass in a reggae band that never quite made it.
profile.education: Some college (audio engineering), left to tour
goals: Be ÉCLAT's resident producer when it opens
Sign the first artist out of Livéra
Win Aaliyah back, or stop wanting to
ambitions: Run his own label from Low End Studios
profile.social_preferences: The center of every room, then gone without saying goodbye.

secrets.truth: 'Golden Hour' uses a sample he never cleared. If the rights holder finds out, the song that made his name gets pulled.
He moved to Livéra because Aaliyah did.

social_media.bio: Producer. Golden Hour. Livéra's loudest neighbor.

life_history: Made beats in his grandmother's back room at fourteen.
Toured as a DJ for three years.
Produced 'Golden Hour', a regional hit, at twenty-six.
